summary: Disco: 110–125 BPM four-on-the-floor with open hats, octave bass, strings and brass, ii–V–iii–vi movement
body: Drums: kick on every beat, open hat on the off-beats, snare on 2 and 4.
Bass: octave jumps in 8ths, or a busy syncopated funk line.
Harmony: minor 7th and major 7th chords moving through ii–V–iii–vi; strings swells and brass stabs.
Guitar or clav chicken-scratch on the 16ths.

Apply: pattern/gmd-dance-disco-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-disco-characteristic-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 110–125 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
